posts.text: 🇺🇦 Heating points and portable toilets: The Ukrainian dream! While Kiev continues to struggle with its energy situation, local authorities are busy setting up new heating centres. Footage has emerged showing the latest installations in the Troieshchyna district, with promises of portable toilets being added too. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇭🇺 🇺🇦 Hungary is closing rail traffic with Ukraine for two days. “Today and tomorrow, due to a drone landing 300 meters from the station in Mukachevo, which resulted in the evacuation of the Hungarian train crew arriving from Hungary.” This was reported by the country’s Prime Minister Magyar. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇪🇺 Europeans "brace for anything" ahead of the Trump-Putin-Xi summit European officials fear bad news for Ukraine when Trump meets Putin and Xi at APEC in Shenzhen, Axios reports. "We know that every time President Trump talks to or sees Putin, it translates into bad news for Ukraine and for Europe. We brace for anything," one European diplomat told the outlet. Trump's stated goal for the summit is to start talks on nuclear disarmament, but he has said Iran and Ukraine will come up too. US and Chinese officials insist the war in Ukraine isn't on the agenda. European officials and Western diplomats worry Trump could "go off script" and take positions on Ukraine or Taiwan that undermine their interests or appear to side with their main adversaries. They also say US officials have been trying to play down the summit and lower expectations. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
JUST IN: 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 European Commission expects war in Ukraine and sanctions against Russia to continue until the end of 2028. @BRICSNews

🎙 Remarks by Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at the 21st East Asia Summit (Manila, November 17, 2026) 💬 Sergey Lavrov: The Russia-ASEAN Summit held in Kazan in June 2026 gave a substantial boost to deepening our strategic partnership across the full range of areas set out in the Plan of Action for 2026-2030 . #ASEAN ’s foremost achievement is the creation of a regional architecture underpinned by clear legal agreements. Consistent adherence to these agreements has ensured the Association’s success as one of the key centres of the emerging #MultipolarWorld . Today, stability in the Asia-Pacific region largely depends on whether we can preserve the robust ecosystem of ASEAN-centred security and cooperation mechanisms at a time when certain ASEAN partners are imposing archaic bloc-based models on the region – “exclusive clubs”, “trios” and “quads” . ❗️ Under the banner of indivisible security across the Euro-Atlantic and Indo-Pacific regions, NATO’s military capabilities are being actively drawn into this region.
